title: System boundaries
description: Local city, workers and PostgreSQL with the optional IAM-authenticated GCP judgement boundary.

title: Meal handoffs
description: Queued household, restaurant, market, dispatcher and courier handoffs with explicit substitution consent and physical arrival.

title: An agent's transaction
description: A committed attempt reservation precedes the atomic transaction for tool effects, memory, outgoing events and ACK.

title: Restaurant supply and consent
description: Ingredient sourcing and shortage forwarding return to the restaurant; substitutions require household approval.

title: Delivery queue lineage
description: Inventory, fulfillment, dispatch and physical world events pass through the PostgreSQL queue.

title: GCP component boundary
description: The scoped local workers invoke a dedicated GCP project through the CloudJudge client and Cloud Run IAM.

title: Durable inference lifecycle
description: Short transactions persist request, dispatch and result around provider I/O. Fresh validation commits an approved or denied receipt, memory, outbox and ACK atomically; an uncertain dispatch is never automatically resent.
